title: לגן באוטובוס
subtitle: אמא, טוהר והלני נוסעות בבוקר

day.tohar: a soft mint-green jacket over a cream romper, cream tights and small white shoes.
day.heleni: a navy coat with toggle buttons, a red knitted scarf, mustard tights, red shoes and a small red backpack.

night.tohar: pale yellow pajamas with tiny blue buses.
night.heleni: lilac pajamas with tiny yellow buses.

coverScene: A sunny morning street. Mom holds Tohar on her hip and Heleni's hand; all three stand at a little bus stop, smiling and waving at a friendly round blue bus that is arriving.

pages.text:
השמש עולה, הבוקר מאיר,
אמא מעירה: קומו, יום חדש ובהיר!
pages.scene: Morning sunlight in the girls' bedroom. Mom sits on the edge of the bed gently waking the two sisters, who stretch and rub their eyes in their pajamas.

pages.text:
נעליים, תיק, ומעיל קטן,
היום באוטובוס נוסעות לגן.
pages.scene: In the entrance hall, Mom kneels and zips up Heleni's coat while Tohar, already dressed, sits on a little bench holding one of her own shoes. Heleni's small red backpack hangs by the door.

pages.text:
בתחנה מחכות, יד ביד,
אוטובוס כחול מגיע מיד.
pages.scene: At a little bus stop with a bench under a tree. Mom holds Tohar on her hip and Heleni's hand. Heleni points down the street, where a friendly round blue bus is coming.

pages.text:
הדלת נפתחת: פְּשְׁשְׁשְׁ, עולים!
הנהג מחייך: בוקר טוב, ילדים!
pages.scene: The blue bus door is open. Mom climbs the step with Tohar on her hip, Heleni stepping up beside her. The kind bus driver, a smiling man with a grey moustache and a blue cap, waves hello from his seat.

pages.text:
טוהר על הברכיים של אמא נשענת,
והלני ליד החלון, מסתכלת ומספרת.
pages.scene: Inside the bus. Mom sits on a seat with Tohar on her lap leaning against her. Heleni kneels on the seat beside them by the window, pointing out and talking excitedly.

pages.text:
רואים כלב קטן ועץ גבוה,
וציפור על חוט, ושמש צהובה.
pages.scene: The view through the round bus window: a little dog walking on the sidewalk, a tall green tree, a small bird sitting on a wire, and a warm yellow sun. Heleni's and Tohar's faces are seen at the edge of the window, looking out.

pages.text:
רמזור אדום: עוצרים, מחכים,
רמזור ירוק: שוב נוסעים.
pages.scene: The blue bus waits at a traffic light that glows soft green. Through the front windshield, Heleni stands beside Mom's seat pointing at the light; the driver nods with a smile.

pages.text:
האוטובוס מתנדנד, טוהר צוחקת,
אמא מחבקת, והלני מצטרפת.
pages.scene: Inside the bus as it sways gently. Tohar laughs on Mom's lap, Mom hugs her, and Heleni leans in to join the hug, all three laughing together.

pages.text:
על כפתור אדום הלני לוחצת,
דִּינְג! האוטובוס עוצר, והיא קופצת.
pages.scene: Heleni stands on tiptoe pressing a round red stop button on a bus pole, jumping a little with joy, while Mom, holding Tohar, smiles at her.

pages.text:
להתראות, נהג, תודה רבה!
הגן כבר כאן, עם גדר צבעונית ויפה.
pages.scene: The three of them stand on the sidewalk and wave goodbye to the blue bus as it drives away; the driver waves from his window. Behind them is a kindergarten gate with a colorful painted fence and flowers.

pages.text:
נשיקה מאמא וחיבוק חזק,
בצהריים היא חוזרת, וכבר מתגעגעת קצת.
pages.scene: At the open kindergarten gate, Mom kneels and gives both girls a big warm hug and a kiss. Inside the yard behind them are a small slide and colorful toys.

pages.text:
בערב אמא שרה שיר שקט,
לילה טוב, טוהר והלני, מחר שוב נוסעים, לאט לאט.
pages.scene: Night in the girls' bedroom, soft lamp light. The two sisters are fast asleep side by side in bed, peaceful faces, eyes closed, a small toy blue bus between them. Mom sits beside the bed, gently tucking the blanket, smiling. A soft moon in the window, the room dim dusty blue with a faint warm glow.
